{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABYjnOPg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhCIaqI", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 13, "title": "Complete Sega Saturn hardware emulation and deliver legally distributable game demos", "body": "## Problem

The original comprehensive hardware Issue #11 was closed after the **partial SH-2 PR #12** merged, even though both the PR and [hardware conformance matrix](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/hardware-conformance.md) explicitly state that the complete Saturn hardware acceptance criteria remain unmet. Its [closure comment](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/issues/11#issuecomment-6292152071) attributes the premature closure to the GitWeave workflow following a merged upstream result, **not** to verified hardware completion.

This is a **new, authoritative end-to-end completion Issue** replacing the remaining scope of #11, without reopening #11. The goal is an independent, broadly functional Sega Saturn emulator for the browser, **plus useful fully lawful ROM/disc-image demos** that prove diverse hardware functions.

### Closure rule — important

**Keep THIS Issue open until ALL mandatory pre-merge acceptance criteria below have been satisfied and verified.** A partial CPU, device, demonstration, or optimization PR must not be treated as resolution. Multiple focused PRs are welcome, but use plain references such as "Related to this hardware-completion Issue"; do not apply GitHub closing keywords or mark the comprehensive Issue as fully resolved on partial PRs. Inspect the GitWeave/automation issue-close behavior; if it forcibly closes the tracker merely on a partial merge, correct or bypass that behavior (and restore this Issue's open state) rather than treating closure as evidence of completion. A merge event, green workflow or number of checked-off subtasks is not by itself the completion criterion.

## Expected outcome

Build a **complete functional baseline for the standard built-in Sega Saturn hardware**, written **from scratch in Rust**, targeting both native test execution and WebAssembly on GitHub Pages. Model the public programming contracts of:

- Master + slave Hitachi SH-2 and their SH7604 on-chip resources;
- Sound MC68EC000;
- Main bus, BIOS/memory mirrors, cartridge address decoding for the base system, backup memory and clocks;
- SCU (DMA, interrupt controller and executing DSP);
- VDP1 + VDP2 with combined rasterization and display/blanking behavior;
- SCSP synthesis, 32 slots, sound DSP and CD-DA;
- SMPC system management, RTC and controller ports;
- Runtime CD block, TOC/sector/audio tracks and BIOS/boot services;
- User-provided original BIOS **or** a genuinely functional independently implemented BIOS-less HLE path.

The result must continue to load original, license-cleared Saturn-targeted disc images locally and support **multiple independent demos** illustrating meaningful video, audio, input, dual-CPU and disc functionality — not simply replay a special-cased script or host-side JS game.

A functional baseline is **not a claim of 100% commercial-game compatibility, analog-perfect timing or fixed performance/FPS**. However, a missing standard built-in subsystem, an unimplemented documented instruction family, or a silently ignored register is an unresolved required gap.

## Context and reproduction

New feature/completeness work; reproduction steps not applicable. At the time of drafting:

- PR #12 / main commit `80cb1509c96aea110f559ed41b200516c6d007c1` expanded master SH-2 to decode 142 architectural instruction forms, with exception/IRQ tests. Opcode classification is not proof of entire chip/system fidelity.
- Existing `src/cpu.rs`, `src/cpu/tests.rs`, `src/bus.rs`, `src/devices.rs`, `src/disc.rs`, `src/lib.rs`, `src/wasm.rs` and `web/` cover a narrow **Star Collector** HLE/VDP2/SMPC path; the remaining requirements are laid out in [docs/hardware-conformance.md](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/hardware-conformance.md) and [docs/validation-issue-11.md](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/validation-issue-11.md).
- The [Play/Debug web app](https://takahirox.github.io/saturn-rust/) and GitHub Pages CI already exist and must not regress.
- Inspect latest `main` before implementing. Follow [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/AGENTS.md), [Issue template](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md), [development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md), and [review guidelines](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/review-guidelines.md). Write Issue/PR titles and bodies, code-facing documentation and commits in **English**.

### Source and implementation rules

Use **original Sega/Hitachi/Motorola hardware manuals** as primary specifications, with feature-by-feature citations and tests; start from the references indexed by [saturn-docs](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs), especially SH-1/SH-2, SH7604, MC68000, SCU/SCU DSP, VDP1, VDP2, SMPC, SCSP/SCSP DSP, CD Block, Boot ROM and Saturn Disc Format manuals. Do not redistribute manuals or copyrighted firmware.

The emulator CPUs and devices must be **independently implemented**; do not incorporate or translate code from Mednafen, Yabause, MAME, 5thPlanet, other emulators, or preexisting CPU/DSP core libraries. Independent black-box/reference comparisons are allowed, with reproducible observations and provenance. Ordinary Rust/Wasm/browser/test infrastructure and *guest-game build tools* are allowed subject to their licenses; game-development SDK libraries are **not** an emulator-core shortcut and require a separate legal audit when included in a game image.

## Required implementation

### 1. CPU correctness and full-system multiprocessor behavior

- Preserve the broad master SH-2 opcode decoding; complete semantic, privilege, exception, address-error, pipeline/delay-slot, IRQ/NMI and edge-case conformance to the Hitachi manuals.
- Implement **a second independently running SH-2** and integrate independent states, reset/start/stop, shared bus, communication/IRQ, cache effects, on-chip FRT/WDT/SCI/DMAC/DIVU/INTC/BSC and other software-visible SH7604 resources, and IRQ acknowledgement/deferral. Detect coherence/ordering faults with deterministic dual-CPU guest fixtures.
- Independently implement the documented applicable **MC68EC000** instruction set/effective-address modes, SR/CCR/USP, supervisor/interrupt/exception behavior and sound-memory/SCSP access. Do not import Musashi or another core.
- Use a deterministic **hardware-time/event scheduler** coordinating all three CPUs, bus waits, DMA, hblank/vblank, video scanlines, timers, sound samples, CD block and SMPC commands. Preserve bounded stepping and a correctness-first interpreter; Web Workers/dynarec are deferred performance work.

### 2. Memory, SCU and built-in system services

- Implement documented standard retail Saturn memory map: all internal RAM/ROM regions and mirrors, CPU on-chip mappings, sound RAM, VDP1/VDP2 VRAM/framebuffers/CRAM/MMIO, SCU, CD, SMPC, backup RAM, byte/word/long access semantics, open-bus/unmapped/error behaviors where software-visible.
- Implement SCU DMA channel modes, transfer source/destination controls, indirect chains, completion/triggers, prioritization, interrupts, bus coordination and **executing SCU DSP** instructions/data movement.
- Implement documented power-on/reset domains, master/slave/sound CPU activation, persistent backup memory, import/export and/or safe local browser persistence with explicit user control and no network transfer.

### 3. VDP1/VDP2 video

- VDP1 command processing and jumps/calls, sprites (normal/scaled/distorted), polygon/line/polyline, color/texture modes, clipping, Gouraud, shadow/transparency/half-luminance, draw status, erasure and framebuffer switching.
- VDP2 NBG0–NBG3 and rotating backgrounds, VRAM banking/cycle patterns, palette/CRAM, tile/bitmap modes, scrolling/zoom, line effects, windows, priority/color math, blending/shadow, interlace/resolutions, timing, and **VDP1–VDP2 composition**. Generate pixels exclusively from guest-written hardware state; no game-specific render hooks.
- Add deterministic guest-level graphics scenes with pixel/framebuffer reference results for independent primitives, overlap, priority, scroll, rotation, palette and display modes.

### 4. Audio subsystem

- Fully integrate 68k with sound RAM/SCSP registers, 32 slot PCM and FM-related operation, pitch/envelopes/LFO/looping/mix, timers, MIDI/IRQ and **executing SCSP effects DSP**.
- Produce deterministic stereo sample buffers and deliver audio to the browser (e.g. AudioWorklet). Handle browser user-gesture restrictions, underflow and mute honestly.
- CD-DA decoded/routed through documented sound mixing with tested timing and track controls. Verify measurable non-silent audio from **guest-issued register commands**, not a JavaScript sample substitute.

### 5. CD/media/BIOS

- Runtime CD-block command/status/HIRQ, seek/read/audio, TOC/sessions, filter/partition/selector/buffer and sector transfer behavior as seen by the SH-2, with realistic software-visible timing.
- Support **cooked ISO and BIN/CUE**, 2352-byte raw sectors, multiple files/tracks, pregaps and mixed data/audio where relevant; strict validation of malformed files and missing CUE references. CHD and other compressed media are optional.
- Support two **distinct selectable boot paths**:
  - User supplies a legally obtained genuine Saturn BIOS **locally**; run its actual reset/init flow without redirecting into HLE, with evidence of a BIOS menu/boot milestone beyond synthetic vector stepping.
  - BIOS-less HLE provides enough documented startup, BIOS-system, backup and CD services (correct ABI, side effects and regional/version notes) to boot the supported representative homebrews. Do not embed Sega firmware/SDK code or claim fully universal HLE compatibility.
- Preserve purely client-side BIOS/disc handling on GitHub Pages. No proprietary BIOS, security code, commercial game data, remote uploads, telemetry or CDN requirement.

### 6. SMPC and standard inputs

- Implement SMPC command sequencing, INTBACK, interrupts, RTC, reset/CPU power and region/system flags. Both digital ports and common analog-pad mode should have correctly timed guest-visible responses. Maintain button release on focus loss, Play/Debug navigation and pause; never alter guest game state directly from frontend code.
- Optional special accessories (light guns, multitaps, modem, expansion cartridges, MPEG add-on) are excluded unless explicitly needed to meet a documented base-console test, and must be recorded as unsupported rather than silently mocked.

## Lawfully distributable demonstration games and test ROMs/disc images

**Research, verify rights, and provide useful playable/demo content**, not just the original Star Collector.

For Saturn, retail/game media are generally **CD disc images (ISO, BIN/CUE)**; isolated SH-2 test ROM/binary fixtures are fine for diagnostics but do not prove disc boot. Keep that distinction in the UI and docs.

### Candidate discovery — not pre-cleared assets

Record a reproducible candidate/redistribution table with **source, license, build instructions, availability of a disc image, independently owned assets, bundled SDK/engine objects, requested hardware features and reuse decision**:

1. [Disasteroids](https://github.com/slinga-homebrew/Disasteroids): MIT-licensed *project software* and an ISO release, enjoyable Asteroids-style gameplay; **its included WAV music, other assets, dependencies and release binary are not yet independently cleared for Pages redistribution**. May require controller/Jo Engine, VDP and CD audio paths.
2. [buhman/saturn-examples](https://github.com/buhman/saturn-examples): MIT-licensed source examples including [wordle](https://github.com/buhman/saturn-examples/tree/main/wordle), VDP1/VDP2, SCSP and SCU DSP fixtures. **Not a pre-cleared standalone game image**; check word-list, assets, linked libraries and build chain. Especially useful as a specification-driven hardware exercise.
3. [Noiz2sa Saturn port](https://github.com/willll/noiz2sa-0.51a-saturn): shoot-'em-up port with buildable Saturn ISO/BIN/CUE workflow; top-level license is BSD-2-Clause but **original Kenta Cho game/data, images, BulletML, SDL/SaturnRingLib and any SDK/IP.BIN content require separate provenance review**. Treat as an ambitious compatibility candidate, **not an automatically redistributable ISO**.
4. Existing [Star Collector](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/tree/main/homebrew/star-collector): already original MIT-licensed, buildable, playable. Must remain a regression demo but **does not** exercise the missing full hardware.

Candidate URLs and repository licenses alone are **not approval to bundle their compiled binaries**. A "free download"/"no copyright" credit is not a documented grant for redistribution. Record required attributions, dependency license compatibility, hash/build provenance, and whether web-public redistribution is allowed. If the audit is incomplete, **link to the upstream project only** and let users load authorized local files; do not commit or serve questionable artifacts.

### Mandatory fallback and demo completion

If no third-party game's **complete** redistribution chain can be established without legal uncertainty, independently author and explicitly license **at least two reproducible Saturn-targeted homebrew demonstrations**, beyond Star Collector:

- A **playable multi-device game** using VDP1 geometry/texture + VDP2 compositing, SMPC input and guest-driven SCSP audio, with score/progress and restart.
- A **hardware showcase/test disc** covering slave/master SH-2 synchronization, SCU DMA+interrupts+DSP, runtime CD sectors and CD-DA, plus SCSP DSP, VDP2 advanced effects and backup-memory behavior. This may be a menu of small guest test scenes rather than a complete game.

A homebrew's actual SH-2/68k/DSP instructions must drive the device behavior. Provide buildable original guest source, deterministic media build scripts, a clear license for every asset, attributions, and automated assertions on rendered frames/audio/guest-visible device state.

Aim for an easy **Play demo** entry point in the existing polished UI; users may select each legally bundled image or their own authorized supported discs locally. No host-coded replacement gameplay or game-specific MMIO hooks.

## Verification and closure requirements

Maintain and continuously update [docs/hardware-conformance.md](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/hardware-conformance.md) with **one traceable row per relevant instruction family, on-chip resource, chip register/command family and significant output mode**. Each row must contain primary manual citation, implemented semantics, test IDs, native/Wasm evidence, limitations, and an explicitly failing/pending status until satisfied. Update the document's title and Issue references to track **this new Issue** rather than continuing to say closed #11 “must remain open”.

A register accepting writes but doing nothing is not coverage. No mandatory feature may be marked complete solely by unit tests that never drive the actual guest hardware path. Partial PRs should be scoped, reviewed, merged and recorded as progress, while the master Issue remains open. Document every outstanding test/hardware gap.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

**All items are mandatory before a final PR may resolve this Issue; a partial PR does not have to satisfy the entire list but must not close the Issue.**

- [ ] Full documented architectural SH-2 and applicable MC68EC000 instructions/flags/exception behavior have semantic tests; SH7604 on-chip units and integrated dual SH-2/sound-CPU execution are exercised by guest fixtures (not opcode decode alone).
- [ ] Shared hardware-time scheduler and complete base memory/bus/reset/backup models work across CPU, DMA, audio, video, IRQ and CD event boundaries with deterministic native test traces.
- [ ] SCU DMA modes/interrupts and **running SCU DSP** are tested by independent guest programs.
- [ ] VDP1 and substantial full VDP2 programming-model coverage, including rotation/window/priority/color math and VDP1/VDP2 composition, produce deterministic testable pixel outputs from multiple original scenes.
- [ ] SCSP slots/timers/interrupts/**running sound DSP**, MC68EC000-directed PCM/FM and mixed CD-DA produce measurable audio in native tests and audible output in the browser after user consent/gesture.
- [ ] Runtime CD-block commands, ISO/BIN/CUE raw and mixed-track loading, TOC/sector data, errors/IRQ and BIOS/HLE/CD service contracts are guest-testable without game-specific bypasses.
- [ ] Real externally supplied BIOS (locally and lawfully tested) reaches a meaningful BIOS init/menu/boot milestone beyond reset vectors; HLE remains separately functional with documented contracts; no proprietary BIOS or disc is committed. If physical/user BIOS access is needed, explicitly request the minimum lawful local verification and document its result without exposing firmware.
- [ ] SMPC commands/INTBACK/RTC, dual digital ports/analog controller mode, local backup data, input focus safety and correct boot/reset/persistence transitions pass native and browser checks.
- [ ] Existing Star Collector behavior and original synthetic CPU ROM tests still pass; the two independently built and licensed new demos above execute *real guest code*, with Playwright tests for input, frames, non-silent audio, interrupts/CD/DMA effects, completion/restart and error cases.
- [ ] An evidence-linked conformance matrix shows **no unfulfilled mandatory standard built-in subsystem** from this Issue, with limitations and exclusions honestly recorded; no silent stubs, copied emulator cores, copyrighted Sega content, unlicensed assets or falsely claimed commercial compatibility.
- [ ] All repository checks (`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, Clippy, Wasm build/target Clippy, reproducible homebrew builds and actual Chromium Playwright tests) pass on the final tree. GitHub Pages project-subpath publishing and Play/Debug behavior remain supported.
- [ ] Repository/project automation does **not** close this tracker on intermediate PR merges. A final resolution requires the entire acceptance list and documented review; do not use a partial merge as the closing signal.

## Optional validation

Independent reference-emulator or lawful hardware comparison, extra licensed homebrews, other browsers, physical gamepads, performance baselines, save states, CHD and optional expansion peripherals. Web Workers, dynarec/JIT, SIMD and sophisticated speed tuning remain separate **post-correctness** experiments. None is needed to accept a correctness-focused partial PR.

## Required post-merge verification

After the **final comprehensive implementation** is merged and GitHub Pages deploys, verify the publicly hosted Play/Debug app, legal demo discs and local-file modes on https://takahirox.github.io/saturn-rust/, including VDP graphics, guest-driven audio, input, CD image loading, system test scenes and resource/failure handling. Record exact deployed SHA, workflow run and results. This public deployment check is possible only after merge and is not a pre-merge gate.

**Do not reopen #11; use this new Issue as the authoritative comprehensive tracker. Do not claim the full hardware project is finished until its mandatory criteria pass.**
